faq.title: Answers to your frequent questions.
faq.description: A few pointers to prepare your enquiry and find the right page.

calls.question: How do I submit a project to a call?
calls.answer: Follow the instructions and submission channel specified in the relevant call. For a question, include the name of the call in your message.

access.question: How do I request access to research platforms?
access.answer: Specify the platform, the purpose of your tests and your preferred dates. Contact us to discuss access conditions.

visits.question: Can I visit a platform?
visits.answer: Contact us with the site, number of visitors and preferred dates to enquire about possible visits.

careers.question: How do I apply for a job or internship?
careers.answer: Use the application channel specified in the relevant vacancy. For a question, choose the “Careers & internships” subject.

press.question: How do I request an interview or a speaker?
press.answer: Choose the “Communications & press” subject and specify the media outlet, topic, format and preferred date.

publications.question: Where can I find the Institute’s publications and reports?
publications.answer: Visit the Publications & reports page. If you are looking for a particular document, include its title or topic in your message.
